lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A cluster of approximately 15 high-intensity circular pixel groups arranged in an irregular triangular distribution posterior to the fifth branchial slit, primarily situated in the mid-right portion of the frame.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical alignments of elevated pixel luminance intersecting with horizontal spot-bearing regions to form a grid of high-intensity nodes on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct linear feature running horizontally across the upper flank, marked by a sharp transition from high-luminance dorsal pixels to a lower-luminance shadow region below.
